about: The brief's exact voiceover script, placed against the cut (seconds on the film timeline). The delivered film has no voiceover: no recorded or licensed voice was available, and a synthetic voice would not meet the brief. These cues are ready for a recording session; tools/captions.mjs turns them into captions.
direction: Confident, mature, cinematic. Natural and assured, measured pauses, rising energy. Pronunciation: confirm 'CampOS' with the brand team before the session (the likely reading is 'Camp O-S', as in operating system). Òrìṣun is Yorùbá: 'OH-ree-shoon', low tone on Ò and rì, mid tone on ṣun, ṣ as 'sh', the final n nasalising the vowel.

lines.text: What if campus was more than a place?
What if it was a world of its own?
A campus you don't just visit.
